name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother, I'm heading out ahead of you!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm just in that kind of mood today!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well then, see you at the academy!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Heading over to Big Brother's place now?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, aren't you out pretty early today, Mako-chan?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Um... a lot happened, and it was kind of awkward to stick around, or rather, um...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I-I just felt like it, that's all!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Sis Nana, is there someone you like?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wha-wha--?! What are you suddenly blurting out, you little--!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, well, I mean, it's not like there isn't, or maybe it's not quite enough to say there is...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Of course I love Master, and I love everyone else in our group too, but...」

name: Macaron
message: 「It feels kinda different from that, or rather...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Still, it's not like I dislike Big Brother, so...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I guess... maybe I do like him.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jeez... why are you asking about that all of a sudden?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Sis Nana, if someone you liked told you they liked you, how would you reply?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaa!? How could I ever say something so embarrassing!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Sorry for asking something weird! See ya!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What was that all about first thing in the morning...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Asking something like that, don't tell me... did something happen between her and Synn!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you doing leisurely watering the fields for?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you telling me to let an important source of nutrition wither away?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's not what I mean! With Mako-chan, um, well...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gahhh~! Like I could ever talk about someone I like in front of Synn, it's way too embarrassing!」

name: Synn
message: 「You were worried about me, huh. Thanks.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, shall we have breakfast? Macaron went ahead and prepared it for us.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh my, if it isn't the little sister.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wh-Wha!? What kind of playful teasing is that supposed to be!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Tell me, big angel, is there someone you like?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Someone I like, you ask. Let's see...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I love Lolotte, Macaron-san, the president and the others--everyone, really.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then, what would you do if those people told you they liked you?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「What would I do... I'd be super happy, of course?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina~, I love you so much too~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Just like this, you should simply express your feelings honestly.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「This is just our own way of showing affection.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「People who like each other should be free to share their feelings with one another.」

name: Macaron
message: 「People who like each other, freely, huh...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Incidentally, I believe the Vice President is quite knowledgeable when it comes to girls loving each other.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ho-ho. That's the exact look you'd give a bitter vegetable.」

name: Misa
message: 「H-hey! Because of you, Lolotte-san, she's got the wrong idea about me!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's not like homosexuality is a hobby of mine or anything!」

name: Misa
message: 「The one I revere is strictly Lady Ria alone!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, though, Macaron-san is quite lovely too, perhaps right up my alley...」

name: Misa
message: 「A-Ah, of course, that's not romantic feelings or anything, just a simple feeling of sisterly affection, I suppose...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. Well then, Amyrina, see you after school.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yes. Do your best with your studies, okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's up? Does that handkerchief taste good?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, why am I getting yelled at...?」
Did she already go into her room?

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron~, you have to wash your hands and gargle when you get home~」

name: Synn
message: 「Doing it later isn't good enough, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm worried, so I'll go check on her for a bit.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Pretending to be nice just to sneak into a girl's room--I'd expect nothing less from the Demon Lord!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm just worried about her as her landlord.」
Come to think of it, I haven't actually been inside Macaron's room yet.
You're pretending not to be home, aren't you.

name: Synn
message: 「If that had hit me, I would've died, you know!?」
Besides, in a cramped place like this, how could you even--

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why do you have a tent pitched inside your room...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Eh? Oh, I just couldn't really settle down, y'know. Hehehe.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Doing it like this makes it a cozy space?」

name: Synn
message: 「This is your room, Macaron, so I don't mind if you make it comfortable for yourself.」

name: Synn
message: 「More importantly, it looked like you were holed up in your room--are you okay? Feeling sick or anything?」

name: Macaron
message: 「There's no way I can say I was avoiding him because I was too embarrassed to face him...!」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's all because big brother said something weird yesterday...」

name: Synn
message: 「If anything's troubling you, don't hesitate to tell me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Once you live under the same roof, you're as good as family.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... What a simple way of thinking.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I really like that kind side of you, big brother!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is it just me, or is it getting warm in this room?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Synn-sama. Ain't she not even paying rent in the first place?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, come to think of it, that's true, yeah, uh-huh.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Uuu~... If someone says they like you, you say you like them back. Freely, and honestly!」

name: Macaron
message: 「To be able to withstand this level of embarrassment... Angel-chan is truly terrifying...」

name: Synn
message: 「What should we do about that, I wonder. Not that it really matters. Since we're family.」

name: Macaron
message: 「H-Huh!? Ah, um, I hate big brothers who nitpick over little details like that!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah, um, that's not what I meant...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Looks like the squirt plans on freeloading here.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I don't really mind if she does, though...」
As long as Macaron stays here with me, I guess I don't really mind.

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll make sure to pay you out of my part-time job wages!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, we can worry about that later.」

name: Macaron
message: 「U-Um, you know, it's not like I actually hate you or anything, okay...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aah, b-but it's not like I like you or anything like that, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Geez, you're such a dummy, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Geez, what am I even supposed to say!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I've never gotten all flustered like this before...」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm getting hungry, so how about we make something to eat soon?」

name: Synn
message: 「Would I just get in the way?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I-I guess I don't have a choice!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll teach you how to cook today too!」
Macaron was acting kind of strange today, though...
The meal the two of us made together was delicious.
